name: powerops
description: Plan, review and gate Microsoft Power Platform builds: powerops-plan turns an idea into a signed-off plan, powerops-review-plan reviews it in a fresh context, and powerops-implement builds only from a signed-off plan, handing the build to Microsoft's skills. Needs the `powerops` CLI on PATH (dotnet tool install --global PowerOps).
